title: Verify: planPreload unit tests
summary: Unit tests for planPreload dedupe and unknown reporting.
description: Write tests from the REQ1 spec using in-memory manifests and scenes only.
acceptance_criteria: Dedupe, unknown and empty cases are asserted
technical_constraints: Build the fixture scene by spreading validScene from tests/fixtures/valid-world.ts, which matches the SceneDef type in src/state/types.ts

steps.action: Create the test file. Define manifest = { version: 1, assets: [{ id: 'A', ... }] } using entries that satisfy AssetEntry from src/assets/manifest/schema.ts. Add test 'dedupes': a scene with two objects that both use asset 'A' gives load ['A'] and unknown []. Add test 'reports unknown': one object with asset 'Z' and one dust effect with asset 'Y' gives unknown ['Z','Y'] and load []. Add test 'empty': validScene gives load [] and unknown [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/planPreload.test.ts -t planPreload
